comparison.gemm_matching: rank, step, layer, projection and launch order; require same kernel and launch geometry

notes: Both timing variants use symmetric memory and the same CE threshold. The NCCL CTA policy differs.
Complete-step timing uses the maximum of the two ranks per step without profiling. NVML maxima are sampled in separate passes.
Trace timing is diagnostic. Exposed waits are device event gaps before parameter copy-out, and GEMM duration differences do not by themselves identify specific resource contention.
